name: Watch keeps its big numbers full size at the largest text size

title: What's new says the missing alert sound is fixed, but it was never proven on the phone that had the problem
what: The newest What's new (0.79.0) tells every member: on some phones gym messages and Rest is over made no sound, now they do. The note written beside that line says it was not yet proven on the owner's OPPO phone, the phone the fix was made for.
expected: A fix is told to members only after it has been heard working on the affected phone, or the line says less.
who: members on OPPO, OnePlus and similar phones
how_often: every rest and every gym message, if the fix does not hold
fix_line: Test rest-over and a gym message with the screen off on the OPPO phone; if silent, fix it or soften the line

title: The feature list says Muscles ready today and Quick workout are live, but the app switched them off
what: What's new 0.73.0 tells members both are gone from the Workout tab, and the Workout tab code says they were switched off on 5 Nov and nothing opens them. Three rows in the feature list still mark them live with no switch.
expected: The feature list marks both as hidden, so nobody tests or sells them as live.
who: the team reading the feature list
how_often: every time the list is used
fix_line: Mark the three rows hidden (switched off 5 Nov 2026)

title: Four older What's new lines describe things the app has since removed or changed
what: Older entries still say: show your workout days to the front desk from My membership (removed 2 Nov); Charts offers one exercise swap for 8 weeks (removed 13 Nov); rest that runs over shows in red (removed 3 Nov); Later on the update pop-up asks again in 3 days (rule replaced). Members no longer see these entries in the app, which shows only the last 3 updates, so nobody is told this today.
expected: The history stays true, or it is clear that old entries are a record of that day only and are never shown again or reused as store text.
who: nobody today; anyone who widens the list beyond 3 updates
how_often: only if old entries are shown again
fix_line: Leave as is, and add one note at the top of the list that entries older than the last 3 are not kept true

title: What's new names a watch text-size fix that has no row of its own in the feature list
what: The newest What's new says the watch keeps its big numbers full size at the largest text size. The watch code has rules for the largest text size, but no row in the feature list covers how the watch behaves at large text, so nothing would send a tester to check it.
expected: A row for the watch at the largest text size, pointing at the watch screens, so it gets tested.
who: members who use the largest text size on a watch
fix_line: Add the row with its entry point and mark it live once the screens are checked at the largest text size
